meta.origin: Mirdyne PRISM Professor Briefing deck, 29 Aug 2026: 960 x 540 pt slides mapped x1.5 to a 1440 px canvas.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and slide ground. Paper carries the narrative; navy carries dark slides, the evidence console and closing sections.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, process steps, object cards and panels, on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, labels and strong text on ground and surface. Paper 16.8:1 on ground; navy 17.7:1 on ground, 15.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body, lead, captions and source lines on ground and surface. Paper 5.8:1 on ground, 6.2:1 on surface; navy 10.8:1 on ground, 9.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks and the dashed border of neutral pills. The deck's own source-line grey measures 4.0:1 on paper ground, below AA for small text: set source lines in ink-2 on the web. Navy 6.3:1.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table top and bottom, card and panel borders. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables, lists and stacks.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Kickers, links, Awarded and In-use pills, the base case in charts. As text on ground, surface and accent-tint: paper 8.0:1 on ground, 7.7:1 on tint; navy 8.7:1 on ground, 7.3:1 on tint.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind accent text in pills; the base-case area in charts.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Connectors, timeline dots, the outer manufacturing window. Marks only: 3.0:1 on paper ground, 5.4:1 on navy. Never text on paper.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Contracted and Prototype pill borders, the upside series, the manufacturing window core. Marks and fills. The deck's teal measures 3.9:1 on its own tint, so teal as text uses teal-text.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal as text: pill labels and upside figures. Paper 4.8:1 on teal-tint and 4.9:1 on ground; navy 5.1:1 on teal-tint.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind teal text in pills; the upside area in charts.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Signal: the current timeline dot, the optimum point, In-development and Interest pill borders, a zero that matters. Marks; 4.6:1 on paper ground, 3.6:1 on navy. Small text uses crimson-text.

tokens.name: crimson-text
tokens.usage: Crimson as text: pill labels and the Problem-it-solves label. Paper 4.8:1 on crimson-tint, 5.0:1 on ground; navy 5.1:1 on crimson-tint.

tokens.name: crimson-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind crimson text in pills.

tokens.name: emphasis
tokens.usage: The one filled element of a group: the last process step, the primary button, the decision node. Always paired with on-emphasis.

tokens.name: on-emphasis
tokens.usage: Text and marks on emphasis: 17.7:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2 px solid outline, offset 3 px. 8.0:1 on paper, 8.7:1 on navy.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy, the same in both themes: the letterbox around the deck stage and the chrome band.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The footer band on every slide and the site footer.

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Company name and slide position in the band: 17.7:1.

tokens.name: on-chrome-2
tokens.usage: The programme line in the band (PRISM · FREEDOM TO BUILD) and footer body text: 9.7:1.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bold sentence headlines, as in the deck. Sizes are at the 1440 px canvas; the website scales them with the viewport (see README).

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Specify the capability. We deliver the material.
styles.usage: Hero and cover titles only. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Materials decide what engineers are free to build.
styles.usage: Slide and section headlines: one full sentence, ending with a full stop.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Freedom to build beyond today's materials.
styles.usage: Second line of a cover; headings inside a section.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Hero figures. Light weight, tabular lining numerals; always with a label and a source line.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: PRISM changes the starting point: define the capability first.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline, in ink-2.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.sample: The material should follow the mission.
styles.usage: One bold statement per section, in ink or accent.

styles.name: row
styles.sample: The first project built around the complete PRISM loop.
styles.usage: The claim in a status-table row.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every result feeds the next round, with its evidence attached.
styles.usage: Running text on the website, in ink-2.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: First application: alloys for rocket engines.
styles.usage: Notes under figures and card body text.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Set in capitals (text-transform: uppercase) with the tracking given.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Above every headline, in accent. The deck's 9.5 pt, 160 spacing.

styles.name: column
styles.usage: Table headers and group labels, in ink-2.

styles.name: source
styles.sample: Source: Kusne et al., Nature Communications 11, 5966 (2020).
styles.usage: Source and image-credit lines, in ink-2. Every figure and photograph has one.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Geist Mono is an addition to the deck's single family: machine identifiers read as identifiers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Object properties, rights manifests, hashes and IDs.

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: Object types and rights states, in capitals.

spacing.note: 4 px base. The deck's 41 pt slide margin lands on space-16.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside pills and between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps in grids of cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between process steps; around the connector.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section head and its body on small screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Slide side margin (deck 41 pt x 1.5).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between stacks on the website.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding at full width.

radius.note: Near-square, as the deck's rounded rectangles: never round except dots.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, process steps, buttons, object cards (deck 2.88 pt).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Large panels, images and the manufacturing-window frame (deck 3.6 pt).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status and maturity pills (deck 5.76 pt on a 22 pt pill).

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Timeline dots and released or public rights glyphs only.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and border.

tokens.name: chrome-height
tokens.usage: Height of the footer band (deck 25 pt x 1.5).

tokens.name: layout-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on the website.

tokens.name: layout-gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter on the website, 20 px on phones.

tokens.name: ease-rise
tokens.usage: Section reveals (700 ms, 18 px rise) and button-arrow nudges.
